meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在 cmem.ai 上搜索你的 Claude-Mem 记忆——里面存着过去各会话带时间戳的观察记录。它先用关键词粗搜、再细查，最后用通俗语言把相关记忆讲给你听，不直接倒出原始搜索结果。
howto.when: 当你说「search memory」「你还记得 X 吗」「上次会话我们做了什么」，或想了解某个项目、决定、文件、任务的过往上下文时触发。

say.text: 搜一下记忆里关于这个项目的内容
say.note: Claude 会跑关键词搜索并汇总观察记录

say.text: 你还记得我们上次对 auth 模块做了什么决定吗
say.note: 它会按时间戳给出相关记忆

say.text: 在 claude-mem 里找一下这个报错字符串
say.note: 没结果时会先跑 status 排查

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude searches your Claude-Mem memory on cmem.ai — timestamped observations from past sessions across your agents. It runs broad keyword searches, then narrow ones, and answers in plain language, not raw output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "search memory", ask "what do you remember about X", ask what happened last session, or want prior context on a project, decision, file, or task.

say_en.text: Search my memory for this project
say_en.note: Claude runs keyword searches and summarizes

say_en.text: What do you remember about our auth module decisions?
Find that error string in claude-mem
say_en.note: Runs a status check if nothing returns
